## Completion Report: Work Order 1 — Op Log (`pr-07-v2-storage-wo1`)

### Objective
Implement the append-only op log package in [`internal/core/ops`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops) to serve as the v2 source of truth for all knowledge entries.

---

### Executed Line Items

1. **Op Types and Models** ([`internal/core/ops/op.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/op.go))
   - Defined [`OpType`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/op.go#L11-L20) enum: `add`, `amend`, `supersede`, `retire`, `move`, `split`.
   - Defined [`Op`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/op.go#L33-L41) struct containing `Type`, `EntryID`, `DossierScope`, `Timestamp`, `Source`, `SessionID`, and `Fields`.
   - Defined [`OpBatch`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/op.go#L44-L49) struct containing `Version`, `Ops`, `CreatedAt`, and `BatchID`.
   - Added ULID helpers: [`NewBatchID`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/op.go#L52-L54), [`NewBatchIDWithTime`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/op.go#L57-L59), [`NewEntryID`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/op.go#L62-L68), and [`NewBatchWithTime`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/op.go#L94-L105).

2. **Op File I/O**
   - [`internal/core/ops/writer.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/writer.go): Defined [`Writer`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/writer.go#L11-L13), [`NewWriter`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/writer.go#L16-L20), and [`Writer.Write`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/writer.go#L24-L47) storing batches at `.memory/ops/<yyyy-mm>/<batch-id>.json` as indented JSON.
   - [`internal/core/ops/reader.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/reader.go): Defined [`Reader`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/reader.go#L12-L15), [`NewReader`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/reader.go#L18-L22), and [`Reader.ReadBatch`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/reader.go#L33-L56) validating batches on read.

3. **Op Log Iterator** ([`internal/core/ops/iterator.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/iterator.go))
   - Implemented [`Iterator`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/iterator.go#L18-L25).
   - Implemented [`Reader.Iterate`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/iterator.go#L68-L74) yielding `iter.Seq2[*OpBatch, error]` in chronological ULID order across month partitions.
   - Implemented [`Reader.IterateAfter`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/iterator.go#L77-L83) for incremental batch traversal.
   - Implemented [`Reader.IterateBefore`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/iterator.go#L87-L103) resolving git commit timestamps via `git log -1 --format=%cI <commit>` for time-cut replays.

4. **Validation** ([`internal/core/ops/validate.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/validate.go))
   - Implemented [`ValidateOp`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/validate.go#L10-L167) enforcing type-specific field constraints for `add`, `amend`, `supersede`, `retire`, `move`, and `split`.
   - Implemented [`ValidateBatch`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/validate.go#L170-L189) verifying version, batch ID, creation timestamp, and nested ops.

5. **v1 Events Store Retirement** ([`internal/core/ops/migrate.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/migrate.go))
   - Implemented [`MigrateV1Events`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/migrate.go#L13-L46) archiving `.memory/events/` to `.memory/archive/v1-events/`.

6. **Test Suite** ([`internal/core/ops/ops_test.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/ops/ops_test.go))
   - Comprehensive test suite covering round-trip I/O, validation failure cases, chronological iteration, incremental pagination, git time-cut queries, and directory migration using `t.TempDir()`.
